title: An install runs as many workers as its registry's worker role allows
description: One worker profile and a registry worker role of three accounts at concurrency 2: a real loop cycle, control plane and headless dispatch run six ready items as six concurrent worker sessions, each under a worker identity the control plane minted for the loop; master workers 1 limits the next six items to three, and master status shows workers running/allowed.

steps.name: six workers from one profile, then three
